rule: judged at 100 paper copies if it scores 87+ (B+), otherwise at 150, and only with 40+ settled. Score 0-100 from its last 150 copies (after fees; 80 = break-even even in the pessimistic case). Copied at 80+ (B- or better) while its last 50 copies average better than -leeway (5c, +1c per $1 it has made us, +up to 5c for a high score); benched below that, back when it recovers. Size: 90+ = 2, 95+ (300 copies) = 3
